notes: Phase 6 (D-42): (a) with RAG_QUERY_LAYER=false both legacy smoke tiers have every paired difference zero against the Phase 4 baselines, and query-layer-off equals v2-all-off item by item; (b) the default framework (LlamaIndex) with the layer on holds multi_turn, compound and cross_lingual against query-layer-off, with no overall, language or category slice beyond the noise band on Recall@5, Recall@10, MRR or the refusal rates; (c) framework_parity and the paired framework report (rag_eval.compare frameworks --fixtures); (d) transform_delays and voice_budget; (e) the cache-pair run's hit p95 is at most half its miss p95, no near-miss pair hits at the effective distance, the cache-off and cache-on item runs equal the layer-on run item by item, and the two-tenant canary suite with its cache cases passes.
